notes: Audited .env.example, .github/workflows/deploy.yml, astro.config.mjs and src/styles/tokens.css, plus the repo's real risk surface (innerHTML sinks, worker CORS, env exposure). No Critical or High findings. Verified: no secrets in the repo and .env never committed (full git history checked); only PUBLIC_* vars and the ephemeral GITHUB_TOKEN reach CI, the Anthropic key stays in the worker; chat renders model output with textContent; every PageSpeed value entering innerHTML is escaped and finalUrl uses textContent; worker CORS is origin-allowlisted rather than *; the staging noindex control was confirmed working on the live deploy; tokens.css contains no url(), @import or expressions. This record covers commit 6ef6b86, which contains the two fixes arising from this audit: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages pinned from the movable v4 tag to SHA 84c30a85c19949d7eee79c4ff27748b70285e453 (v4.1.0), because that step runs with a contents:write token; and ' escaping added to escapeHtml (defensive, not reachable today). Open and non-blocking: PUBLIC_PSI_KEY is client-side by design and still needs its HTTP-referrer restriction actually applied in the Google Cloud console (worst case is quota abuse, not data exposure); security headers cannot be set on GitHub Pages and are tracked for the production host in renovostudio.com-audit/ACTION-PLAN.md.
